rules.title: Berkeley tenant screening and application fee rules
rules.requirement: Screening fees are capped under state law ($68.96 for 2026) and landlords must give a fee-rights statement before collecting. Berkeley also bars non-refundable fees charged to existing tenants for renewals or roommate changes.
rules.key_value: $68.96 max screening fee (2026), per Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.6
rules.coverage_conditions: Owners charging screening or application fees for Berkeley residential rentals; chapter applies regardless of lease language
rules.quoted_span: The maximum tenant screening fee for 2026 is
rules.interaction: Dollar cap comes from state law (Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.6); the local chapter adds disclosure and existing-tenant fee limits.

notes: Page is a secondary summary; ordinance effective dates not given. State cap statute is cited on the page but is its own record elsewhere.
